grounding.states: Messi won the 2022 World Cup with Argentina

value.answer: Messi, for me. He won the 2022 World Cup with Argentina and was the best player in the world for well over a decade. Pelé is the other name people bring up, but Messi's peak plus that World Cup is what settles it for me. I can't check any current stats right now, but the argument doesn't need them.
